a setting unit that comprises: a punch that is moveable in a feed direction relative to the hold-down device for punching a hole in the workpiece; and a punch sleeve for pressing the connecting element into the hole, wherein the punch and the punch sleeve are connected to one another via an axial forced guidance for a common feed movement in the feed direction, the axial forced guidance being able to be released in a controlled manner, so that the punch is moveable relative to the punch sleeve for the hole punching operation

the control device is set up in such a way that the following steps are carried out: in an initial position, the workpiece rests on the component support; the setting unit moves in the feed direction and the hold-down device presses the workpiece against the component support and the hole punching and hole-forming operation is carried out; the position of the workpiece is fixed by moving in the centering pin; resetting the setting unit against the feed direction and feeding the connecting element into the setting unit; feeding the setting unit in the feed direction and pressing in the connecting element into the workpiece; and returning to a starting position

the control device is configured such that the following steps are carried out during the hole punching and hole forming operation: the hold-down device moves towards the workpiece until a first fixed stop of the hold-down device comes to rest on a stop surface of the feed unit and the hold-down device is blocked from moving back against the feed direction; the embossing sleeve is moved upwards against the feed direction and forms the collar; the hole is punched and a punching slug is removed; and for punching the hole, an axial forced guidance between the punch sleeve and the punch is released
